[[File:FarlanderUniform.jpg|thumb|Keyan Farlander was awarded with several patches for his service in the Rebel Alliance, many of which were placed on his sash.]]

A '''sash''' was an article of clothing. It was often used for ceremonial purposes on a military uniform in various militaries at various instances in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Time/Legends|history]]. They sometimes carried various patches representing actions they undertook during their service in a military.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] possessed a sash on his Rebel uniform, of which he had at least 18 [[Battle Patch]]es and 3 [[Flight Badge]]s by the time of the Battle of Yavin. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] wore an honor sash from his days as a [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]].
